A BlitzLLVM extension: sets what the system is told about the brightness of the picture while [AutoHDR](AutoHDR) shows it in HDR, through the HDR metadata of the graphics API (Vulkan and Direct3D 11; OpenGL has none, so this does nothing there). Some displays use it to decide how to map the picture to what they can show. A value of 0 keeps the default of that value: no black level, an average of SDR white, and a maximum that is the peak of the display ([HWHDRPeakNits](HWHDRPeakNits)). It is not measured from the picture. Takes effect with the next picture.
@param minimum  The darkest value in nits.
@param average  The average brightness of a picture in nits.
@param maximum  The brightest value in nits.
